verdict.rationale: Gazebo provides enabling building blocks: headless server-only mode, a lightweight GUI-free server package, remote simulation over Gazebo Transport, custom robot and sensor plugins, and multiple physics engines. None of the evidence shows a synthetic training-data pipeline or any reinforcement-learning workflow, and nothing documents running at scale. Missing for 10: explicit synthetic data generation (labeled sensor or image output), RL environment interfaces or integrations, parallel or large-scale batch simulation, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
